singleSourceCaveat: SINGLE-SOURCE year. cardboardconnection.com returned HTTP 404 on every 2019-specific URL tried and its site search surfaced no usable result; tcdb.com blocked every attempt with HTTP 403. This package rests on baseballcardpedia.com alone for 2019. Not a source DISAGREEMENT (the task's exclusion trigger) -- no second source was reachable to agree or disagree with. Flagged here rather than silently treated as equal-confidence to the 2018/2020/2024 packages, which each have two-source or better corroboration.
